items.title: How I Code With AI
items.summary: Four projects, four ways of using AI, and why staying in control of the design matters more than how much code the AI writes.

items.title: Learning OCaml With Claude: The Full Conversation
items.summary: The complete conversation in which Claude guided me through writing and testing an OCaml function without writing the solution for me.

items.title: RAG pipeline (Qualcomm)
items.summary: The retrieval pipeline for a Qualcomm analytics chatbot, built in a five-week Mines Field Session; raised the average similarity score of retrieved chunks from 0.74 to 0.86.

items.title: Superior Flat
items.summary: A Fabric mod for Minecraft that adds six flat world presets which keep the biomes, villages, and a flat Nether and End, with 2,017 downloads on CurseForge.

items.title: CSV email extractor
items.summary: A short Python script that turned my dad's hours of copying email addresses out of a spreadsheet into a 30-second run.

items.title: Rubik's Cube solver
items.summary: A C++ program that scrambles a Rubik's Cube and solves it with the beginner method a person would use, showing each stage with SFML.

items.title: Qwixx scoresheet
items.summary: An interactive scoresheet for the dice game Qwixx in Python and Tkinter, with eight variations that shuffle the numbers and colors on the card.
